command: set -eu; tar -xz --no-same-owner -C /work; autonomous-traffic doctor > /work/doctor.json; autonomous-traffic htc-local --batch /work/batch --jobs 2 > /work/execution.json; autonomous-traffic htc-collect --batch /work/batch --output /work/collected > /work/collection-summary.json; tar -czf - -C /work doctor.json execution.json collected batch/results
execution_label_note: htc-local labels the orchestration as local_native_not_container_or_pool; it was invoked inside the isolated Docker container by the command above. No pool execution occurred.
